caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a lightly yellowed, off-white paper background. The object is a peacock depicted in grayscale pencil or charcoal, with its body facing forward and its head turned slightly to the left. The peacock’s tail is fully fanned out, filling a rounded, scalloped shape behind its body and displaying multiple feather segments adorned with detailed patterns. The drawing includes variations in shading to suggest texture and depth, particularly in the tail feathers and the bird's body. Beneath the peacock, centered on the lower part of the image, is the handwritten name “Helen Hobart” in cursive. There are no other objects, colors, or background elements present in the composition.
title: Pin Tray
